article: One paused-in RC62 in pump-cartridge lower cradle and one in enclosure front-top
customer_outcome: Seat all four tubes to their insertion stops and retain reliable pogo contact without cartridge creep

related_float_observation.scope: Successful paused RC62 insertion and initial overprinting in an ASA Aero float. Material, ring orientation, geometry and thermal exposure differ from the cartridge retention pair.

accepted_pump_holder_fit.scope: Both pumps held firmly with holder screws tightened and no vertical play. This does not establish the RC62 pair's force or pogo contact behavior.
